headline: AI leaders urge government action on automated AI
summary: Top AI labs like OpenAI and Google signed a statement. They advocate for slower frontier AI development. The goal is coordinated global governance efforts.

headline: Man charged for wiping phone during airport search
summary: A Georgia man faces a felony charge for allegedly wiping his phone. Customs and Border Protection questioned him at an airport. This occurred during a search activists often face.

headline: AI costs surge, making Wall Street nervous
summary: Google's spending estimate jumped to $205 billion, up from $190 billion. This increase surprised investors during earnings season. High AI investment costs are raising concerns.

headline: Dual-source gaming headset on sale for $25
summary: The EPOS H3 Hybrid wired gaming headset is now 75% off. It's available for just $24.99 at Woot. This budget-friendly headset can play audio from two sources.

headline: Wolfbox 2-in-1 Car Jump Starter and Tire Inflator for $42
summary: Get the Wolfbox 2-in-1 Cordless Car Jump Starter and Tire Inflator. It's nearly 50% off, priced at just $42 with shipping. Never be stranded on the road without proper tools.

headline: Double Fine lays off 25% of staff; Xbox responds
summary: Double Fine, known for Psychonauts, laid off 25.6% of its employees. This follows Xbox's recent massive restructuring efforts. The studio is transitioning to independent status.

headline: Iniu 10,000mAh Power Bank extends Switch 2 playtime for under $10
summary: The Iniu 10,000mAh Power Bank costs less than $10. It can more than double Nintendo Switch 2 play time. This allows simultaneous play and charging.

headline: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle now streaming on Crunchyroll
summary: The highly anticipated Demon Slayer: Kimetsu No Yaiba Infinity Castle is finally available. It is now streaming exclusively on Crunchyroll. Fans can watch the movie adaptation.

headline: Video captures powerful Japan earthquake
summary: A strong earthquake struck Japan's Kyushu island on July 28. Video shows the moment it hit various locations. The footage reveals the impact across the region.

headline: Parents on benefits to receive up to £4,500 for child's apprenticeship
summary: Some parents on benefits will receive up to £4,500. This incentive is for their child starting an apprenticeship. The aim is to encourage apprenticeship uptake.

headline: UEFA and PM criticize Infantino's World Cup plan
summary: UEFA and Prime Minister Andy Burnham expressed criticism. They oppose FIFA's plan for private investment in competitions. This includes proposals concerning the World Cup.

headline: French wildfires flare up amid 40C heatwave threat
summary: Wildfires in south-west France have reignited. Firefighters are preparing for a new 40C heatwave. Rising temperatures could complicate containment efforts in Gironde.
